summary: Getting too close to an end gateway causes the game to crash
description: The bug Going too close to the end gateway will cause the game to crash! Stack trace 1.15 Pre-release 1 : [^crash-2019-11-21_23.27.56-client.txt] Description: Rendering Block Entity java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 16 out of bounds for length 16 at java.base/jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.outOfBounds(Preconditions.java:64) at java.base/jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.outOfBoundsCheckIndex(Preconditions.java:70) at java.base/jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.checkIndex(Preconditions.java:248) at java.base/java.util.Objects.checkIndex(Objects.java:372) at java.base/java.util.ArrayList.get(ArrayList.java:458) at dsy.a(SourceFile:41) at dsx.a(SourceFile:30) at dsx.a(SourceFile:11) at dsk.a(SourceFile:106) at dsk.b(SourceFile:95) at dsk.a(SourceFile:127) at dsk.a(SourceFile:95) at dqm.a(SourceFile:1180) at dqi.a(SourceFile:719) at dqi.a(SourceFile:549) at dbj.d(SourceFile:941) at dbj.b(SourceFile:576) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:202)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition 1.15 Pre-release 1.
2. Create or load a world with the End dimension accessible.
3. Travel to the central island in the End dimension.
4. Locate an end gateway portal on the central island.
5. Approach the end gateway portal until you are within close proximity (approximately one block away).
6. Observe that the game crashes upon getting too close to the end gateway portal.
7. Take a screenshot or record the crash report for documentation purposes.
8. Exit the game and gather the `debug` folder and `crash-reports/*.txt` file from the `.minecraft` directory.
9. Attach the screenshots, debug ZIP, and crash report to the bug report.
Observed Behavior: When a player gets too close to an end gateway, the game crashes immediately. This occurs specifically with version 1.15 Pre-release 1 and involves rendering issues related to the block entity of the end gateway. The crash is accompanied by a stack trace indicating an `IndexOutOfBoundsException` where index 16 is out of bounds for length 16. The error originates from the ArrayList.get method, suggesting that there might be an issue with how data structures are being accessed or manipulated when rendering the end gateway. This bug can be consistently reproduced by approaching an end gateway in the End dimension, and it affects both single-player and multiplayer modes. To provide developers with more context, attaching a screenshot of the affected area and compressing the game's debug folder into a ZIP file would be helpful. Additionally, capturing the `latest.log` and the corresponding crash report from the `crash-reports` directory can offer further insights for debugging this issue.
Expected Behavior: When approaching an end gateway, the game should remain stable and not crash. Players should be able to move freely near the structure without any issues. The expected behavior includes rendering the end gateway and its surrounding environment correctly, allowing players to interact with it normally as intended in the game mechanics.
